description: Closed finite controls witness each direct-core and full retained-core single-premise omission. A debt case has possible later ability without present ability or actual repayment; a destroyed-original case retains duty and accountability without future original-return ability while compensation is future-feasible but not owed. A lapsed duty coexists with accountability. The future-ability repair is composed from the exact imported compatibility theorem under a duty-to-ideal bridge and ideal/future overlap, with the old certificate reused. All are stipulated formal cases, not empirical possibilities or moral facts; attribution deferred, root-premise delta zero.
